metric_contract.exact_total_top1_accuracy: one and only one total-goal bucket is predicted; full sample denominator unless an explicitly reported selective-coverage arm is used
metric_contract.top_k_coverage: realized bucket appears anywhere among k predicted buckets; never report as exact accuracy
metric_contract.contiguous_range_coverage: realized total lies inside the reported ordered total-goal interval; never report as exact accuracy
metric_contract.conformal_set_coverage: realized total belongs to the calibrated set; report set size together with coverage
metric_contract.selective_exact_accuracy: exact Top1 accuracy on a stated retained subset; always report retained coverage and frozen selection rule
metric_contract.prohibited_metric_substitution: do not describe top-k, interval, conformal-set or selective coverage as full-coverage single exact-total accuracy
